title: Still Saying "Raining Cats and Dogs"? Textbook English vs Real English #shorts
description:
Textbook English vs real English: "It's raining cats and dogs." Hardly anyone says that anymore - it mostly lives on in textbooks. What people really say when it rains hard:
• It's pouring!
• It's really coming down!

Native speakers still understand the idiom; it just sounds old-fashioned.
